subject: microbiology
title: Bacterial Genetics II: R Factors, Beta-Lactamases, ESBL, Carbapenemases and mecA

steps.tx: The **R factor** (resistance transfer factor) proved in 1959 Japan that multiple drug resistance crosses between Shigella and E coli patients as one transferable unit: a resistance transfer factor (conjugation machinery) plus resistance determinants, foreshadowing every multi resistance plasmid since. Its discovery converted antibiotic resistance from mutation watching to epidemic tracing.
steps.say: Resistance travels as a unit between species; R factors announced the plasmid epidemic era.

left.title: R factor anatomy
points: Selection by any one cargo drug maintains all

right.title: Modern descendants
points: Co selection by metals and biocides
Curing and incompatibility as research tools

steps.tx: **Mutation** remains resistance's other engine: spontaneous chromosomal changes (about 1 in 10 million per gene per generation) selected by exposure (streptomycin ribosomal mutations, fluoroquinolone gyrase steps, rifampicin rpoB single step to high level resistance, hence tuberculosis never rifampicin alone). Mutator strains and stress induced mutagenesis accelerate the supply under therapy.
steps.say: One rifampicin tablet can select its own resistance; mutation frequency writes combination rules.

left.title: Mutational resistance
points: Single step high level: rifampicin, streptomycin

right.title: Acquired resistance contrast
points: Often multi drug in one event

steps.tx: **Beta-lactamases** hydrolyse the beta lactam ring across Ambler classes: A (penicillinases, ESBLs, KPC), B (metallo enzymes NDM, VIM, IMP needing zinc, spared by aztreonam but usually co resistant), C (AmpC cephalosporinases), D (OXA types including carbapenemases). Inhibitors (clavulanate, avibactam, vaborbactam, relebactam) rescue partners class selectively, avibactam covering KPC and OXA48 but not metallo enzymes.
steps.say: Name the Ambler class and the inhibitor answer follows; metallo enzymes defeat all current inhibitors.

left.title: Class map
points: A: TEM, SHV, CTX M ESBLs; KPC carbapenemase

right.title: Inhibitor coverage
points: Clavulanate and tazobactam: class A penicillinases, ESBL variable
Avibactam: A, C, OXA48; not B
Aztreonam stable to B, destroyed by co produced A and C (avibactam partner)

steps.tx: **Beta lactamases** cut the beta lactam ring and are sorted by the Ambler scheme. Class A includes ordinary penicillinases, extended spectrum enzymes, and KPC carbapenemases. Class B enzymes such as NDM, VIM, and IMP need zinc, are metallo enzymes, are usually spared by aztreonam, and travel with other resistances. Class C covers AmpC cephalosporinases. Class D covers OXA types, including some carbapenemases. Clavulanate, avibactam, vaborbactam, and relebactam rescue a partner drug only for selected classes. Avibactam covers KPC and OXA 48, not the metallo enzymes.
steps.say: Ambler class tells how a beta lactamase works and which inhibitor might help. Class A holds penicillinases, extended spectrum enzymes, and KPC. Class B metallo enzymes such as NDM need zinc, escape current inhibitors, and are often spared by aztreonam while carrying other resistances. Class C is AmpC. Class D includes OXA types. Avibactam covers KPC and OXA 48, not class B.

vis.alt: A family tree divides beta lactamases into Ambler classes A, B, C, and D, with example enzymes and the inhibitors that cover them.
vis.caption: Classes A, B, C, and D branch by active site chemistry, with penicillinases, metallo enzymes, AmpC, and OXA types placed on separate limbs. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **ESBLs** (extended spectrum beta lactamases, CTX M family dominant globally, gut colonising E coli and Klebsiella) hydrolyse penicillins, third generation cephalosporins and aztreonam, are inhibited by clavulanate (the confirmatory test), and spare carbapenems and cephamycins. Community urinary sepsis increasingly arrives ESBL armed, rewiring empirical choices from the pharmacology lessons.
steps.say: CTX M in the gut is why community sepsis prescriptions changed worldwide.

left.title: ESBL portrait
points: CTX M dominant over TEM and SHV mutants

right.title: ESBL consequences
points: Piperacillin tazobactam debated in bloodstream infection
Travel and antibiotic exposure risk factors

steps.tx: **Carbapenemases** close the beta lactam era locally wherever they spread: KPC (class A, avibactam covered), NDM and other metallo enzymes (class B, no inhibitor cover, first characterised from New Delhi in 2008 as **NDM-1**), and OXA48 like (class D, weak but elusive), detected by phenotypic (mCIM, Carba NP heritage) and molecular tests, treated by ceftazidime avibactam, meropenem vaborbactam, cefiderocol and aztreonam combinations by class.
steps.say: Carbapenemase class is the prescription: KPC, NDM and OXA take three different exits.

left.title: Detection
points: mCIM and inhibitor based phenotypic tests
PCR panels from colonies and rectal swabs

right.title: Therapy by class
points: NDM: aztreonam plus ceftazidime avibactam, cefiderocol

steps.tx: **Carbapenemases** locally end reliable beta lactam therapy wherever they spread. KPC is class A and avibactam covers it. NDM, characterised in New Delhi in 2008 as NDM 1, and related metallo enzymes are class B with no inhibitor. OXA 48 like enzymes are class D, weak but elusive. Lateral flow cassettes, modified carbapenem inactivation, Carba NP style assays, and molecular tests name the class. Treatment then uses ceftazidime avibactam, meropenem vaborbactam, cefiderocol, or an aztreonam combination.
steps.say: Carbapenemase family decides the drug. KPC is class A and avibactam covers it. NDM 1, described from New Delhi in 2008, is a class B metallo enzyme with no inhibitor cover. OXA 48 like enzymes are class D and easy to miss. Phenotypic and molecular tests name the class before ceftazidime avibactam, meropenem vaborbactam, cefiderocol, or aztreonam combinations are chosen.

vis.alt: Lateral flow cassettes display lines that distinguish KPC, NDM, and OXA type carbapenemases from a bacterial colony.
vis.caption: Separate test lines light for class A, class B, and class D carbapenemases so the enzyme family is named at the bench. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **mecA** encodes PBP2a, the low affinity transpeptidase that makes Staphylococcus aureus methicillin resistant (MRSA) by building wall while beta lactams sit on native PBPs, carried on SCCmec chromosomal cassettes, detected by cefoxitin screening and mecA or PBP2a tests, with mecC a rarer cousin. Vancomycin, daptomycin and ceftaroline (the PBP2a binding cephalosporin) answer it from the pharmacology side.
steps.say: mecA swaps the wall builder for one beta lactams cannot bind; cefoxitin reports it.

left.title: mecA mechanics
points: PBP2a low affinity for beta lactams
SCCmec types grade community versus hospital strains

right.title: MRSA consequences
points: All beta lactams except ceftaroline class unreliable
PVL strains and community skin sepsis
Screening and decolonisation in defined settings
VISA and VRSA are separate further steps

steps.tx: **AmpC** beta lactamases (chromosomal inducible in Enterobacter, Citrobacter freundii, Serratia and kin, the SPACE group) derepress under therapy into cephalosporin resistance mid course, so initially susceptible Enterobacter bacteraemia treated with ceftriaxone can relapse resistant; cefepime and carbapenems sidestep. Plasmid AmpC (CMY) exports the problem to E coli.
steps.say: Enterobacter can learn cephalosporin resistance during the course meant to cure it.

left.title: AmpC behaviour
points: Third generation cephalosporins unreliable in deep infection

right.title: AmpC answers
points: Avoid ceftriaxone in high inoculum Enterobacter

steps.tx: **Resistance stewardship genetics** closes by linking mechanism to the earlier pharmacology: every empirical prescription should ask which of enzyme, target change, porin loss or efflux the local antibiogram implies, because each has a different successor drug and a different infection control urgency. Carbapenemase producers trigger isolation; mutational resistance mostly triggers a prescription change.
steps.say: Enzyme, target, porin or pump: mechanism chooses the next drug and the isolation sign.

left.title: Mechanism to action
points: Efflux: multi class low level patterns

right.title: Control urgency
points: MRSA and VRE: isolation by policy
Sequencing resolves plasmid versus clone outbreaks
